parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under both `Examples/` and `WallpaperSampleApp/` — path locations that the decision rules treat as sample-app restraint markers regardless of the `is_sample_app` boolean value. The canonical production implementation of `DebugMetricsProvider.measureCPUUsage` already exists in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). The copy in `DebugHUD.swift` is a local convenience for the Wallpaper sample app's debug overlay and is intentionally isolated from the production `DebugPanel` package. Lifting the sample-app copy into shared production code would couple the `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical restraint pattern.
